sources.entry: Vercel AI SDK - TypeScript toolkit for building AI-powered applications with streaming, agents, and tool calling. #free #opensource

summary.name: AI SDK
summary.one_liner: A unified open-source TypeScript SDK (npm package "ai") from Vercel for building AI-powered apps and agents with streaming, fallbacks, and multi-model support.
use_cases: Building AI chatbots with streaming responses
Switching between LLM providers without rewriting code
Creating AI agents with tool calling
Building a Slackbot that responds to messages using an LLM
Building a natural-language SQL agent for PostgreSQL
Adding AI features to React, Next.js, Vue, or Svelte apps
summary.what_it_does: The AI SDK is an open-source TypeScript toolkit installed with npm install ai. It provides a unified API to generate text from many models, with streaming responses, built-in fallbacks, and support for switching providers with one line of code. It is framework agnostic and lists integrations with Next.js, React, Svelte, Angular, Vue, Nuxt, and Solid, plus Node.js. The page also points to related Vercel offerings: AI Gateway for routing to models through one endpoint, Sandbox for running agent-generated code, Workflows for long-running agents, and AI Elements, a UI component library.
notable: Unified API across 100+ supported models and multiple providers
Built-in fallbacks and streaming without custom parsing
Compatible with Vercel AI Gateway for routing through one endpoint
caveats: Ecosystem features such as AI Gateway, Sandbox, and Workflows are Vercel services and may carry their own terms (page does not specify pricing)
Page does not state pricing for AI Gateway or other hosted services
